items.text: Lori Smith is an educator from Long Grove with nearly 30 years in special education as a teacher and school administrator in public and private schools. She is a learning behavior specialist.

sentences.text: Lori Smith is an educator from Long Grove with nearly 30 years in special education as a teacher and school administrator in public and private schools.
She is a learning behavior specialist.

items.text: At a League of Women Voters forum, Smith said she believes life begins at conception and said Illinois law is settled on the subject. She says her first bill would repeal the Illinois vehicle emissions inspection program for non-commercial gasoline vehicles. She opposes the countywide 1 percent school sales tax, saying it adds to property taxes. She criticized state spending of $70 million on one-time $400 payments to people affected by federal SNAP cuts.
